info.text:
In 2025, US sportsbooks kept about 10 cents of every dollar bet.

2025: $166.94 billion bet, $16.96 billion kept (American Gaming Association).
At -110, two $110 bets bring in $220; the winner gets $210; the book keeps $10, about 4.5%.
Parlays carry bigger edges. DraftKings kept 7.1% of $53.6 billion in 2025 after promos.

Sources: AGA (Feb 2026), DraftKings 10-K FY2025.
